title: Mega Man Battle Network 6: Cybeast Gregar

info.about: Mega Man Battle Network 6: Cybeast Gregar and Mega Man Battle Network 6: Cybeast Falzar are 2005 tactical role-playing games developed and published by Capcom for the Game Boy Advance (GBA) handheld game console.
info.trivia: Capcom released it in Japan in November 2005 and in North America in June 2006, split into Cybeast Gregar and Cybeast Falzar versions.
info.why: It arrived in North America well into the Nintendo DS era, and the 2023 Mega Man Battle Network Legacy Collection renewed interest in the original cartridges.
